# Saucelabs

Sauce Labs provides a comprehensive continuous testing cloud for web and mobile app testing across browsers and devices.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/saucelabs/.

## Actions

- **List Jobs** (read-only): Retrieve all jobs for a SauceLabs user.
- **List VDC Jobs** (read-only): List virtual device cloud (VDC) testing jobs for a Sauce Labs user.
- **Get API Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current operational status of Sauce Labs services.
- **Get Appium EOL** (read-only): Retrieve end-of-life information for Appium versions.
- **Get Performance API Definition** (read-only): Retrieve the OpenAPI/Swagger JSON documentation for the Sauce Labs Performance API.
- **Get Supported Platforms** (read-only): Get supported platforms for an automation API.
- **Get Tunnel Versions** (read-only): Retrieve information about available Sauce Connect tunnel versions.
